terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: NOLA Atlas (nolaatlas.com){operated_by} ("we", "us"). These terms apply to your use of the site. By using it you agree to them; if you don't, please don't use the site.

sections.heading: What the site is
paragraphs: NOLA Atlas is a free reference for general information, built from public records and third-party data about homes in New Orleans and Metairie. It is not financial, investment, legal, tax, insurance or real estate advice, and nothing on it is an appraisal, a broker price opinion, a title search, a survey, an offer to buy or sell property, or an insurance quote.

Flood zones shown are read from FEMA's published maps for a parcel's location. They are not an official flood zone determination, an elevation certificate or a flood insurance rating. Flood scores from FloodLens are model estimates.
Consult a licensed professional (appraiser, real estate agent, attorney, insurance agent, surveyor or financial advisor) before making decisions based on anything here.

sections.heading: Accuracy of the data
paragraphs: Data comes from the sources listed on the About page and is shown as of each source's last refresh. It may be incomplete, out of date or wrong, and we don't verify it.

Owner names, addresses and other parcel details are copied as published from the public records of the Jefferson Parish Assessor, the Orleans Parish Assessor and the City of New Orleans. The rolls lag sales, inheritances and other transfers, can contain errors and may still name a former owner. Properties are grouped under an owner by matching the name as written, so an owner page may combine different people or businesses who share a name and may miss properties listed under another spelling or entity. Nothing here is proof of who owns a property: for legal, lending or tax purposes rely on the parish Clerk of Court's conveyance and mortgage records and the Assessor's official records. To correct a record, contact the Assessor's office; corrections made there appear here after the next refresh.

sections.heading: Not a consumer reporting agency
paragraphs: We are not a consumer reporting agency as defined by the Fair Credit Reporting Act (15 U.S.C. § 1681 et seq.), and the site doesn't provide consumer reports. You may not use it to decide anyone's eligibility for credit, insurance, employment or housing, to screen tenants, or for any other purpose covered by that Act.

sections.heading: Acceptable use
paragraphs: Use the site lawfully. Don't use it to harass, stalk, threaten or intimidate anyone, or to discriminate against anyone, including in violation of the Fair Housing Act. Don't download its data in bulk by automated means in a way that burdens the site (ordinary browsing and search engines that follow robots.txt are fine), try to get around its security, interfere with the watchlist sync service, or suggest that we or our sources endorse you.

sections.heading: Your watchlist and sync
paragraphs: Your watchlist is stored in your browser. If you turn on sync, an encrypted copy is stored on our server under a code only you hold; anyone you give the code or its link to can see and change the list, so keep it private. We delete synced lists nobody has synced for 400 days, and we may change or discontinue sync. Keep your own copy (the watchlist's Copy link) of anything you can't afford to lose.

sections.heading: Other sites and data providers
paragraphs: NOLA Atlas School Finder (schools.nolaatlas.com) and FloodLens (flood.nolaatlas.com) are separate sites {same_operator}, each with its own sources and notes. Links to other sites are for convenience; we don't control them. Data from third parties is subject to their own terms, and their trademarks belong to them. NOLA Atlas is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by either Parish Assessor, the City of New Orleans, FEMA, the U.S. Census Bureau, Zillow, Redfin, realtor.com, Freddie Mac, the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis or any other data provider.

sections.heading: Our content
paragraphs: The site's design, text, charts and code are © {owner}. The underlying public records and third-party data belong to their sources. You're welcome to link to any page and to quote short passages with a link back.

paragraphs: The site and its data are provided "as is" and "as available", without warranties of any kind, express or implied, including warranties of accuracy, completeness, merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose and non-infringement, to the fullest extent permitted by law.

Because the site is free, our total liability for any claim relating to it is limited to one hundred U.S. dollars ($100).

Nothing in these terms excludes or limits liability that the law doesn't allow to be excluded or limited, including liability for intentional or gross fault or for physical injury (Louisiana Civil Code article 2004).

sections.heading: Changes
paragraphs: We may change, suspend or stop any part of the site at any time. We may update these terms; the date at the top shows the latest version, and using the site after a change means you accept it.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: NOLA Atlas (nolaatlas.com){operated_by}. This policy says what leaves your browser when you use the site and what we keep. In short: no accounts, no ads, nothing sold, and the addresses and names you search for aren't sent to our analytics.

sections.heading: Usage counts
paragraphs: We count visits with Google Analytics, which sets cookies, and Cloudflare Web Analytics, which doesn't. They receive which tabs are opened and which features are used (for example, that an owner-name search ran or a school link was opened), plus what those services read from any web request, such as browser type and approximate location. They never receive the addresses, names or parcel numbers you search for, or what you save to your watchlist. Google Analytics is told not to use the data for ad personalization or Google signals. If your browser sends Global Privacy Control, Google Analytics isn't loaded at all; you can also opt out with Google's opt-out browser add-on or an ad blocker.

sections.heading: Flood details
paragraphs: When you open a property report, its map point (latitude and longitude) is sent to FloodLens (flood.nolaatlas.com), a flood-risk service {same_operator}, to read the flood details for that spot. FloodLens logs each lookup for its own usage counts, with the point rounded to about a kilometer and your IP address stored only as a keyed hash.

sections.heading: Your watchlist and sync
paragraphs: The addresses, ZIP codes and owners you save are kept in your browser only. A watchlist's Copy link puts the list in the part of the link after "#", which browsers don't send to any server: it goes only where you paste it.

If you turn on sync, your browser makes a sync code and encrypts the list with a key derived from it before sending a copy to our server. We store that encrypted copy, an identifier and a hash of a write token (both also derived from the code) and the time it last changed. The code never leaves your devices, so we can't read your list. Lists nobody syncs for 400 days are deleted, and Delete synced copy on the watchlist page removes one at once.

sections.heading: Stored in your browser
paragraphs: The site keeps a few things in your browser's local storage so they're there on your next visit: your light or dark theme, the ZIP Scorecard's cost assumptions, your watchlist and, if you turned it on, your sync code. Clearing this site's data in your browser removes them.

sections.heading: Hosting
paragraphs: The site is served by GitHub Pages through Cloudflare, which process each request, including your IP address, to deliver the site and protect it from abuse, under their own privacy policies. We don't add our own logs of visits.

sections.heading: Public records
paragraphs: Owner names and property details come from public records published by the Parish Assessors and the City of New Orleans; we don't collect them from you. A question about a record belongs with the Assessor's office, whose roll this site reflects after each refresh.

sections.heading: What we don't do
paragraphs: We don't sell or rent personal information, show ads or build profiles of visitors. The site isn't directed to children under 13.

sections.heading: Changes
paragraphs: If this policy changes, the date at the top changes with it.
